params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $pidToStop=84736; $p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$pidToStop" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($p -and $p.Name -eq 'Runner.Worker.exe' -and $p.ExecutablePath -like 'C:\Users\Xxkan\actions-runner-heaven\*'){ taskkill /PID $pidToStop /T /F | Out-String | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'STALE_WORKER_ALREADY_GONE_OR_IDENTITY_MISMATCH' }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -in @('Runner.Listener.exe','Runner.Worker.exe') -and $_.ExecutablePath -like 'C:\Users\Xxkan\actions-runner-heaven\*' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CreationDate | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
